Hi Laura / Priyom —

Draft below. I kept each to 2–3 sentences and added suggested artifact names in parentheses. Please flag edits.

Hosted: Redwood's Hosted offering is a fully managed cloud API where Redwood runs the inference service in our multi-tenant public cloud environment. We isolate customer data logically and enforce strict access controls; Redwood manages infrastructure, keys (KMS), and updates. Evidence: SOC 2 report, hosted_tenant_isolation_diagram.pdf, hosted_kms_primer.pdf.

Dedicated: Dedicated provides a reserved GPU pool and a single-tenant runtime where capacity is dedicated to the customer but the control plane is still managed by Redwood. Customers enjoy stronger isolation and predictable throughput; physical GPUs are shared only across the customer's reserved nodes. Evidence: dedicated_deployment_matrix.pdf, SLA_commitment_HELI-5421.pdf, audit_logs_sample.csv.

Private (VPC / On-prem): Private deployments run inside the customer's VPC or on-premises environment; networking, egress, and physical infrastructure are under customer control. Redwood provides a customer-controlled control plane option and offers KMS/HSM integrations so keys never leave the customer's boundary. Evidence: vpc_network_diagram.png, kms_integration_guide.pdf, private_installation_checklist.docx.

Note: we should avoid absolute statements like "no data ever leaves" — instead say "under customer-controlled network boundaries".

Cheers,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Laura / Aditya —

Small edits to Aditya's draft — tightened language and suggested the exact filenames HelioMed can attach in their packet. I also added one line for the customer responsibility split so it's clear which controls HelioMed would own.

Hosted: Redwood Hosted is a managed public-cloud API where Redwood operates the serving runtime and infrastructure. Customer data is isolated logically; Redwood manages operational controls and standard key management. Evidence: SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf, hosted_tenant_isolation_diagram.pdf, hosted_kms_primer.pdf. Customer controls: application access, data classification.

Dedicated: Dedicated provides a single-tenant runtime (reserved GPU capacity) managed by Redwood with stronger tenancy guarantees and predictable latency. Physical resource pools are reserved for the customer; the Redwood control plane remains managed. Evidence: dedicated_deployment_matrix.pdf, SLA_commitment_HELI-5421.pdf, audit_logs_sample.csv. Customer controls: network ACLs, application creds.

Private (VPC / On-prem): Private runs inside the customer's VPC or on-prem environment. Networking, routing, and KMS keys are controlled by the customer; Redwood provides the software/runtime to install or a customer-dedicated control plane. Evidence: vpc_network_diagram.png, kms_integration_guide.pdf, private_installation_checklist.docx. Customer controls: key lifecycle, host hardening, internal network.

I've attached a short "deployment_matrix" PDF and a VPC network diagram for their packet (filenames below).

Attachments included: redwood_deployment_matrix.pdf, vpc_network_diagram.png

Hosted: Redwood Hosted is a managed public-cloud API where Redwood operates the service and manages infrastructure and standard key management. Customer data is logically isolated; we also support customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK) for tenants that require them. Evidence to attach: SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf; hosted_tenant_isolation_diagram.pdf.
